title: ACM Problem-Solving Platform
description: A web application designed to help users solve ACM-style competitive programming problems.

features.name: Problem Repository
features.description: A comprehensive library of ACM-style problems categorized by difficulty and topic.

features.name: Code Editor
features.description: An integrated code editor with syntax highlighting and support for multiple programming languages.

features.name: Online Compiler
features.description: A feature to compile and run code submissions directly on the platform.

features.name: User Profiles
features.description: Profiles for users to track their progress, solved problems, and rankings.

features.name: Leaderboard
features.description: A ranking system to display top users based on their problem-solving performance.

features.name: Hints and Solutions
features.description: Optional hints and detailed solutions for problems to aid learning.

constraints: Requires a scalable backend for compiling and running code.
target_users: Competitive programming enthusiasts, students, and professionals preparing for ACM contests.
data_requirements: Storage for user profiles, problem data, code submissions, and leaderboard rankings.
